display_long_description:
Race from the driver's seat in Extreme Tracks, a single player VR car racing game that takes you from city circuits to snowy mountain roads and desert buggy tracks.

A NEW VIEW AROUND EVERY CORNER
Drive through daytime city scenery, race beneath nighttime lights and take on mountain routes surrounded by snow.

CAR AND BUGGY RACING
Experience enclosed car cockpits and open buggy frames. Head from road racing into the desert for a different view of the action.

STAY IN THE DRIVER'S SEAT
Take on bends and straights from a firstperson cockpit view, with other racers on the track.

SINGLE-PLAYER, OFFLINE PLAY
Play seated with Touch controllers. An internet connection is not required for gameplay.

Early Access: The game is still in development.
Comfort level: Intense.

Take the wheel. Take on Extreme Tracks.
